sentences.target: '-(으)므로'는 원인이나 이유를 격식 있고 객관적인 방식으로 제시할 때 사용한다.
sentences.en: This form is used to state a reason or cause in a formal and objective manner.

sentences.target: 보고서, 공문서, 공식 안내문 등에서 매우 자주 쓰인다.
sentences.en: It is very common in reports, official documents, and public notices.

sentences.target: 일반 구어에서는 거의 사용되지 않으며 문어적인 색채가 강하다.
sentences.en: It is rarely used in everyday speech and has a strongly written tone.

sentences.target: 주관적 감정이 아닌 객관적·사실적 이유를 설명할 때 적절하다.
sentences.en: It is suitable for presenting factual or objective reasons rather than personal feelings.

sentences.target: 뒤 절에는 결론, 조치, 지침 등의 내용이 오기 쉽다.
sentences.en: The following clause usually contains a conclusion, action, or instruction.
It sounds more formal than expressions like 'because of'.

sentences.target: 공식 판단이나 정책적 결정을 제시할 때 활용된다.
sentences.en: It is often used when presenting official judgments or policy decisions.

sentences.target: 문장의 흐름을 단정적이고 명확하게 정리하는 효과가 있다.
sentences.en: It helps make the flow of the sentence clear and definitive.

sentences.target: 문맥에 따라 근거 제시, 조건 설명 등의 의미로도 확장 가능하다.
sentences.en: Depending on context, it can extend to giving grounds or explaining conditions.

sentences.target: 문서 작성 시 형식성을 유지하기 위해 선택되는 표현이다.
sentences.en: It is chosen in writing when maintaining formality is required.
The issue has been resolved, so the procedure will continue.
The information has been confirmed, so the report will be submitted.
Staff is insufficient, so the schedule will be adjusted.

sentences.target: 자료가 충분하므로 추가 조사는 필요 없다.
sentences.en: The data is sufficient, so no further investigation is needed.
The conditions are met, so approval has been granted.
There are no errors, so the plan will proceed as scheduled.
The situation has stabilized, so restrictions will be eased.
The request has been repeated, so additional guidance will be provided.
The standards have been strengthened, so the review process will change.
The issue is serious, so immediate action is required.
The records are unclear, so reconfirmation is necessary.
Participation is low, so the schedule will be postponed.

sentences.target: 지원이 확대되었으므로 향후 계획도 조정될 것이다.
sentences.en: Support has expanded, so future plans will be adjusted.
Costs have increased, so a budget revision is unavoidable.
Demand has decreased, so supply must be reduced.
The results are consistent, so the conclusion is reliable.
The environment has changed, so policy adjustments will be reviewed.
Efficiency has dropped, so a change in method is needed.
Opinions have converged, so an agreement can be reached.
Data has been secured, so analysis will begin immediately.
